text:
Maya S: Heads up — multiple customers are seeing hourly usage metrics delayed by ~3 hours in the console. First reports at ~02:10 UTC. Dashboard heatmaps show a gap.

ingest-bot: alert: sink-connector 'console-rollups-sink-1' entered PAUSED state at 2025-06-12T02:07:45Z (consumer group=rollup-sink-1)

Rajat Patel: I see the same. Checked kafka consumer lag:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group rollup-sink-1 --describe
TOPIC                     PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
console-rollups-20250612   0          10234           10234           0
console-rollups-20250612   1           4500            7800         3300
```
Partition 1 lagged badly and the connector paused during compaction/GC.

Samir: Quick repro on staging — connector OOM + compaction pause. Logs show repeated `org.apache.kafka.connect.errors.RetriableException: Failed to flush records` and then `Connector paused`.

Jules H: Steps to remediate I tried locally:
1) `kubectl rollout restart deployment/rollups-sink-1 -n ingest` to recover consumers
2) once consumers steady, run backfill job:
```
run_backfill_rollups --start 2025-06-12T02:00:00Z --end 2025-06-12T06:00:00Z --tenants auto-detect --workers 6
```
3) monitor `rollup-backfill` job logs + `console-hourly-rollups` table row counts

Maya S: Plan: execute restart in prod at :55, then kick backfill. I'll page on-call if restart doesn't clear lag. Notifying affected customers (support ticket #SUP-4921). :eyes:

Rajat Patel: FYI we'll also bump consumer memory and enable smaller flush.interval.ms for the connector to avoid large batches during compaction window.

Samir: Added a short-term autoscale rule so connector gets another replica if lag > 1000 for >5m. Also queued a CICD change to set flush.interval.ms=1000 for rollups-sink-1.

ingest-bot: action: rollups-sink-1 restarted by Maya S at 2025-06-12T02:54:30Z

Jules H: Backfill started at 2025-06-12T02:58:12Z, estimated 22m with 6 workers. Will update when console shows restored hourly rows.

Maya S: Noted. If anyone sees persistent MissingData events in Sentry for the rollup worker, ping me immediately.

Rajat Patel: Post-mortem notes: root cause = Kafka connector flush during broker compaction + OOM on connector pod. Mitigations: memory bump, smaller flush interval, autoscale trigger, alert on connector PAUSED state.

Maya S: Closing loop: customers notified in SUP-4921, metrics backfilled, gap shows as filled in console at ~03:25 UTC. Will file an incident PR with timeline and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
